body_text:
A truth assignment on propositional variables assigns each
variable one of the values true and false and extends
recursively through the connectives. A formula is a tautology
if it is true under every assignment, a contradiction if it is
false under every assignment, and contingent otherwise. These
are semantic classifications of formulas, not additional
connectives.
